setups.why: Internal Bar Strength: closes near the day's extreme tend to revert next days, strongest in equity indices (Pagonidis 2013; documented in index futures/ETFs).
setups.exit_txt: Stop 1.5 ATR, target 1 ATR, time-stop 3 sessions.

setups.label: Failed breakout (rejection)
setups.why: Liquidity grab / stop-run: price trades through a 20-day extreme, finds no follow-through and closes back inside the range -> trapped breakout traders fuel the reversal.
setups.exit_txt: Stop 1.25 ATR (beyond the rejection wick), target 2 ATR, time-stop 5 sessions.

setups.label: Turn-of-month flow
setups.why: Turn-of-the-month effect (Lakonishok-Smidt 1988; McConnell-Xu 2008): pension/payroll flows concentrate equity returns in the last day + first 3 days of the month.
setups.entry_txt: Open of the last trading day of the month.
setups.exit_txt: Exit at the close of the 3rd trading day of the new month; catastrophe stop 2 ATR.

signals.name: USD/CAD
signals.label: Trend pullback (RSI-2)
signals.entry_txt: Next session open (or limit 0.25 ATR better).
signals.exit_txt: Stop 1.5 ATR, target 1.5 ATR, time-stop 7 sessions.
signals.why: Short-term mean reversion inside a long-term trend (Connors RSI-2; short-horizon reversal documented by Jegadeesh 1990 / Lehmann 1990). You buy fear inside an up-trend.
reasons: Price above 200-day average (1.3957 vs 1.3881) -> long-term trend is up
